chunks: And from his sayings (peace be upon him), after he had finished the Battle of Jamal, regarding the censure of women by explaining their deficiency.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about women after the Battle of Jamal?
ai.summary: Delivered in the immediate aftermath of the Battle of Jamal, this saying contextualizes Imam Ali’s critique within the political turmoil of the era, linking women's perceived cognitive and religious 'deficiency' (nuqsan) to their pivotal role in instigating the conflict. Shia scholars often interpret this not as a universal贬低 but as a specific observation of their influence in that historical moment, grounded in the concept of 'shahadah' (testimony) being half that of men.
